title: Wolfia vs Tribble for RFPs and security questionnaires
summary: How Tribble, which answers RFPs, security questionnaires and sales questions, compares with Wolfia’s questionnaires, trust center and contract review.
body_markdown:
How Tribble, which answers RFPs, security questionnaires and sales questions, compares with Wolfia’s questionnaires, trust center and contract review.


Tribble is an answer platform for RFPs, security questionnaires, DDQs and sales, sold as two products, Tribble Respond and Tribble Engage. Wolfia is an AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center, and this page compares the two using only what each company publishes.


## What Tribble is


Tribble describes itself as “the governed answer layer for RFPs, security questionnaires, DDQs and sales.” Tribble Respond drafts RFPs, DDQs, security questionnaires and RFIs from answers a company’s experts have already reviewed, with the source on every answer, and Tribble Engage is an AI sales agent that briefs reps before a call and answers buyer questions during it. Uncertain or low-confidence answers go to the right expert in Slack or Teams before they reach the buyer. Tribble says it is not a trust center platform and works alongside trust center tools.


## What Wolfia is


Wolfia is an AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center. It answers security questionnaires, DDQs and RFPs from a company’s own documents and past answers, gives every answer a cited source, and leaves an answer empty when no document supports it. It works on Excel, Word and PDF files and exports them in their original format, and a Chrome extension fills answers back into web portals. The[Wolfia facts page](https://wolfia.com/facts) lists the rest, including hosting on Amazon Web Services in the United States and SOC 2 Type II.


## Tribble and Wolfia side by side


Tribble cells come from Tribble’s own pages, read 26 November 2026, and Wolfia cells from Wolfia’s published facts.


Tribble Wolfia


Primary use Answers for RFPs, security questionnaires, DDQs and sales, in two products, Respond and Engage, that answer from one knowledge base An AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center


Security questionnaires Reads the questions out of SIG Lite, SIG Full, CAIQ, VSA, spreadsheets, documents and portal exports, and sorts them by control area Answers security questionnaires and DDQs from your own documents and past answers ([Questionnaire Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/questionnaire-automation) )


File formats XLSX, DOCX, PDF and direct portal intake Excel, Word and PDF, exported back in the original format


Web portals Direct intake from vendor portals; a browser extension is not stated on Tribble’s site The Chrome extension extracts the questions from web portals and fills the answers back ([Chrome Extension Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/chrome-extension) )


Trust center Tribble says it is not a trust center platform and complements trust center tools Access requests and online NDA signing, where one signed NDA carries across documents ([Trust Center](https://wolfia.com/products/trust-center) )


RFPs Yes, Tribble Respond drafts RFPs, DDQs, RFIs and long-form narrative sections Answers RFPs from the same documents and past answers

Citations Each drafted answer shows its source and a confidence score Every answer comes with a cited source


Human review “Nothing goes out without a person approving it.” Your subject matter experts review the drafts and only handle the questions where Wolfia is unsure or found no source ([Questionnaire Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/questionnaire-automation) )


Pricing Not stated on Tribble’s site; the price is given on a call Plans start at $500 a month ([Pricing](https://wolfia.com/pricing) )

Hosting region Not stated on Tribble’s site Amazon Web Services in the United States ([Wolfia trust center](https://trust.wolfia.com/) )


Certifications SOC 2 Type II compliant SOC 2 Type II, and certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework


Free trial Not stated on Tribble’s site A “Get started for free” sign-up on wolfia.com; paid plans are scoped on one short call ([Pricing](https://wolfia.com/pricing) )


## Where Wolfia is ahead


Each point below is backed by the table above or by the page it links.


- Wolfia includes a trust center with access requests and online NDA signing. Tribble says it is not a trust center platform.
- Contract review is part of every Wolfia plan. Tribble’s site does not state contract review.
- Wolfia publishes its price, with plans from $500 a month. Tribble gives its price on a call.
- Wolfia’s Chrome extension fills answers back into web portals. Tribble takes intake from vendor portals and does not state a browser extension.


## Which team each fits


Tribble fits a company where proposal writers and sales reps should give buyers the same reviewed answers, with experts approving drafts in Slack or Teams and reps getting answers before and during calls, priced per project for proposals and per user for sales.


Wolfia fits a security or compliance team whose workload is inbound security questionnaires, DDQs and RFPs in files and web portals, and that wants a trust center and contract review on the same plan. It also answers security questions in Slack through the[Slack Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/slack-autorespond) , and in Claude and ChatGPT through the[Wolfia connector](https://wolfia.com/blog/connect-wolfia-to-claude-and-chatgpt) .

## FAQ


### What is the difference between Tribble Respond and Tribble Engage?


Tribble Respond drafts RFPs, DDQs and security questionnaires from answers a company’s experts have already reviewed, and is priced per project. Tribble Engage is an AI sales agent that briefs reps before a call, answers buyer questions during it and drafts the follow-up, and is priced per user.


### Does Tribble include a trust center?


No. Tribble says it is not a trust center platform and complements trust center tools by handling the questionnaire work they cannot fully remove. Every Wolfia plan includes a trust center with access requests and online NDA signing.


### How much does Tribble cost?


Tribble’s pricing page lists no prices. It says the price depends on how many projects a team runs and how many users it has, and is given on a call. Wolfia plans start at $500 a month with unlimited users.


### Do Tribble and Wolfia cite sources?


Yes. Tribble shows the source on every drafted answer, with a confidence score. Every Wolfia answer comes with a cited source, and Wolfia leaves the answer empty when no document answers a question.
